summary: Closure anomalies from the G1/R4 activation: pinned UI playbooks by default, readable composite health reasons, a checked playbooks activation script and a local CI runner for Termux.
root_cause: claw-capability.py and model-fast-path.py fell back to the auto-synced workspace when CLAW_UI_PLAYBOOKS_ROOT was not exported, so the MCP path and the app path could read different playbooks. Composite health reasons such as 'scheduler_health,daily_log_audit' had no label. Activating a playbooks snapshot and running CI on the device were manual and failed on mv -T and TMPDIR=/tmp.
architecture: No new daemon, store or scheduler. An explicit CLAW_UI_PLAYBOOKS_ROOT still wins; otherwise the pinned ~/.openclaw/runtime-ui-playbooks/current is used when present, then the workspace. activate-ui-playbooks.sh tests a worktree before an atomic os.replace of current/previous.
restart_policy: Companion restart for control-health; tier0 package + promote for the termux-lite files.
